projects.title: Xarray-SQL (MEDIUM)
projects.description: Xarray-SQL is an experiment to provide a SQL interface for array datasets. Succinctly, we "pivot" Xarray Datasets to treat them like tables so we can run SQL queries against them — on the query engine of your choice. xarray-sql translates data, not queries: it registers a lazy Dataset as a table on DataFusion (built in), DuckDB, or Polars, and turns any engine's Arrow result back into a labeled Dataset. Dialects, geometry functions, and optimizers stay with the engine.

projects.title: Marin – LLMs (HARD)
projects.description: Marin is an open lab for building foundation models—together. We're training powerful models from scratch, and sharing and programmatically documenting every step: the code, the data, the experiments, the mistakes…all in real-time. We invite anyone who shares our vision of open science and open-source to join and contribute, whether you want to try out a new architecture, training algorithm, dataset, evaluation…there is a lot to do!
